\begin{example} \end{example}[Isoperimetric constant of the unit two-sphere] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0104 1. ch29:29.17\group Isoperimetry

For the unit round sphere, every latitude circle has isoperimetric ratio $4\pi $, and every embedded loop has ratio at least $4\pi $. Thus the isoperimetric constant is $4\pi $. \end{example}
